_comment: Streaming-soak pins PER NUMERIC FINGERPRINT (tests/streaming_soak_test.cpp; 2026-09-22). A failed-tick count on a
seeded 400-tick walk over a VALUE-DEPENDENT rung (MonotoneCubic: the state sits on Hyman branch boundaries, where an
ulp decides the branch) is deterministic for one instruction stream and different for another -- the same seeded
walk read 0 failed ticks on mixed_scheme under Apple clang and 2 under GCC/glibc. So, exactly like the perf
baselines (baselines.json), these rows are keyed by the numeric fingerprint OS|compiler|arch flags|ISA (the CPU
model is NOT in the key: the same instruction stream gives the same doubles on any chip). A row with no entry for
the running key is REPORT-ONLY; the test prints the measured values to paste. Pins only ever RATCHET DOWN per key.
Universal invariants stay hard-coded in the test (every linear rung, and every rung on the smoothed factor walk,
at ZERO failed ticks with the class dq tolerance): those are platform-independent by construction.
Rows: smoothed_per_row = the API Light preset on the PER-ROW stress walk; unsmoothed_factor = no regulariser on the
factor walk. failed = the pin per 400 ticks (scaled to SWAPS_SOAK_TICKS); dq = the quote-space tolerance (rate) of
the delivered curve vs a cold solve of the same objective (a value-dependent rung compares two LM optima on a
kinked landscape, so it is a class tolerance ~1.5x the measurement, not a rounding bound).

Darwin|AppleClang 21.0.0.21000101|-march.note: the reference machine (Mac Pro 2019, Xeon W-3223; perf fingerprint 966685f93279), seed 20260921
